text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx and timeouts for /v1/generate (us-east-1). Error rate ~18% over last 5m, p50 latency up 3x. Paging sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: On it. Looking at Grafana now. Any customer impact flags?

support-lead: CS reports increased user-facing errors for two large tenants (acct: acme-corp, acct: dripai). They're seeing timeouts and 502s. Ticket created.

eng-runtime: I'm checking model-runner pods in us-east-1, seeing restarts on model-runner-3 replica set. Possible OOMs.

michelle (SRE): Can you paste the pod logs? I'll pull node metrics and check OOM killer.

eng-runtime: Pasted snippet: ```
[2026-03-17T20:12:34Z] model-runner[pid=1423]: kv cache allocate failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T20:12:34Z] model-runner[pid=1423]: runtime: goroutine stack exceeds 1000000000 bytes
[2026-03-17T20:12:35Z] kernel: [OOM] Killed process 1423 (model-runne) total-vm:12G, anon-rss:9G
[2026-03-17T20:12:36Z] systemd: model-runner.service: main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```

michelle (SRE): Confirmed OOM. Which models are being served on that pool?

eng-runtime: Mostly open-llama-70B-quant and a Redwood-curated 13B. Config shows some heavy long-context jobs pinned to the 70B instance.

raj (Platform): Quick mitigation: scaling suggestion - drain a few heavy sessions off the 70B workers, re-route to smaller 13B fallback where acceptable. Also enabling autoscale-burst for the pool. Pushing routing change now.

sre-oncall: Doable. michelle, can you trigger a soft drain for model-runner-3 replicas and enable fallback routing?

michelle (SRE): Running drain + rollout: ```bash
kubectl cordon node/gpu-12 && kubectl drain node/gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
kubectl scale deploy/model-runner-13b --replicas=12
kubectl annotate svc/routing fallback=enabled --overwrite
```

eng-runtime: After drain we see steady decrease in restarts, error rate trending down to 6% in 2m. Some clients still hit timeouts due to long tails.

support-lead: CS update: acme-corp sees errors down to ~10% (was 38%), dripai reports heavy tails but mostly OK. They asked for ETA.

sre-oncall: ETA: continue mitigation for next 15-30m. If error rate <1% and stable for 10m, we'll start handoff.

raj (Platform): Also found one model-runner had kernel oops from a GPU driver panic earlier today — patch queued. For immediate fix I recommend restarting the remaining affected nodes (safe restart with drain).

eng-runtime: Rolling restart started on 2 nodes, monitoring. CPU/GPU mem allocs look healthier after throttling long-context jobs (we applied prompt length caps via gateway config).

michelle (SRE): Observability notes: correlate requests that hit 70B and had high token counts, flagged session IDs in traces: s=abc123, s=def456. Will create a short eval to reproduce offline.

sre-oncall: Customer impact assessment: acme-corp partial; high severity but limited affected endpoints. CS ticket updated. No data exfiltration concerns.

support-lead: Logging the incident for postmortem. Need root cause: model-runner memory growth under long-context heavy workloads leading to OOM -> restarts -> increased 5xx.

eng-runtime: Temporary mitigations: fallback routing, drain/restarts, scale-up 13B. Medium-term: enable KV cache quota per-session and better eviction, plus guardrails on allowed context length per plan.

michelle (SRE): Adding runbook action items in incident doc: immediate rollback if error rate rises, postmortem owners: eng-runtime (raj) + SRE (michelle).

sre-oncall: Error rate now 0.9% over 5m. We'll keep monitoring for 30m then handoff to runbook owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged. Handoff scheduled at +30m to eng-runtime and SRE for follow-up and RCA.

raj (Platform): Quick note for RCA: capture heap profiles from model-runner binary and sampling traces for long requests. I'll open infra PR to limit max_tokens-per-request for the pool.

michelle (SRE): Handoff: michelle -> oncall-next (scheduled). Leaving necessary links: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc/5xx-spike, Kibana logs: https://logs.redwood.example/q/3157890123, Incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/IN/3157890123

support-lead: CS will follow up with impacted customers and offer credits if needed.

sre-oncall: Closing live mitigation channel. Follow-up postmortem required — please add notes to the incident doc.
